description: This file defines the 'Resource' class within the SuiteCRM JSON API v1. It handles parsing, validation, and serialization of resource data conforming to the JSON API specification, including managing attributes, relationships, links, and metadata related to a resource.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Represents a JSON API resource, capable of parsing from requests, serializing responses, and managing attributes, relationships, links, and metadata per the JSON API spec.

methods.name: fromJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Populates the Resource object from a JSON API request array, setting id, type, attributes, and relationships.

methods.name: mergeAttributes
methods.description: Merges attributes from another Resource object into this one.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Serializes the Resource into a JSON API response array including all attributes, links, relationships, and meta.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponseWithFields
methods.description: Serializes the Resource with only specified fields.

methods.name: withLinks
methods.description: Sets the links object for the resource.

methods.name: withRelationship
methods.description: Adds a relationship object to the resource.

methods.name: getRelationshipByName
methods.description: Retrieves relationship data by relationship name.

methods.name: getReservedKeywords
methods.description: Returns the list of reserved keywords for JSON API.

methods.name: validateResource
methods.description: Validates that the resource has required 'id' and 'type' fields.

methods.name: relationshipFromDataArray
methods.description: Processes relationships from the input data array.

methods.name: attributesFromDataArray
methods.description: Extracts and filters attributes from the input data array.

methods.name: validateToOneRelationshipFromDataArray
methods.description: Validates a to-one relationship data object.

methods.name: validateToManyRelationshipFromDataArray
methods.description: Validates a to-many relationship data object.
